Fixture
About this fixture

A page to test the review tool on

This fixture is a small built site. It has a heading, body copy long enough to select, a link to a second page, and a pinned scene that holds still while the page scrolls past it.

The regression test clicks the heading, boxes an area, selects a line of this text, notes the pinned scene at a set moment, and follows the link in both frames.

The scene that stays put

This frame is sticky inside a tall track, so its content depends on how far the page is scrolled.

After the scene

Ordinary content again, so the scene's track is only part of the page and reads as a scene, not as the whole document.
